body.p: This communication is being filed to submit additional claims in the instant Application.
No new matter has been introduced in the new claims.
The present application is a continuation application of U.S. Patent Application

17/980,665, which is a continuation application of U.S. Patent Application 17/236,489, which is a continuation application of U.S. Patent Application 16/241,263, which claims priority to U.S. Patent Application 62/614,127.

Applicant hereby rescinds and retracts any and all disclaimers made in any and all parent applications listed above - including U.S. Patent Application 17/980,665 and all patents and applications to which that application claims priority - in response to each and every cited prior art reference, along with any and all other disclaimers made during the prosecution of said applications. Thus, claims pending in the present application are to be examined without prejudice from any representation, statement, characterization, and/or claim amendment made in the identified prior filed patents and applications. The Examiner is encouraged to re-visit each and every reference that was previously used as a rejection against the Applicant's claims in the respective U.S. patent applications, along with the office actions issued in said applications.

Applicants believe that the claims are in condition for allowance. A Notice of Allowance for all claims is respectfully requested. If the Examiner has any questions or comments, the Examiner is requested to contact the undersigned at 515-242-8912.
Respectfully submitted, Fredrikson and Byron, P.A.
